name: smart-container-demo
description: Smart Container Monitoring demo: an API service and a web UI, deployed independently. All data is synthetic.

scripts.vendor: node scripts/vendor-domain.mjs api && node scripts/vendor-domain.mjs web
scripts.dev:api: npm run vendor && tsx watch services/api/src/server.ts
scripts.dev:web: npm run vendor && NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL=http://localhost:4100 npm --prefix web run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: npm run vendor && tsc -p packages/domain && tsc -p services/api && tsc -p web
scripts.test: npm run test:bank && npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
